\section*{Use of generative AI}\label{sec:ai}
\addcontentsline{toc}{section}{Use of generative AI}
The C++ edition of \paglets{} (the runtime, the mesh, the tools, the examples,
the tests and the documentation) and this paper were developed with
substantial support from a generative AI assistant (Claude, Anthropic),
used as a coding and writing agent under the direction and review of the
author. The author set the goals, the design and the acceptance criteria,
reviewed the results, and is responsible for the content. Code written this
way is covered by the test suite described in Section~\ref{sec:evaluation}
and Appendix~\ref{app:reproduce}; the excerpts and result tables in this
paper are generated from the sources and the recorded results, and every
technical statement was checked against the code before publication.
